items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: he wouldn't allow G.G. on the bandstand with him

ctx.x: Because there was nowhere to blow. And (inaudible) with Charlie Parker in ______. That was a long time ago. I remember, the first time I saw him -- the second time I saw him put somebody down. G. G. ______ was
there, and he wouldn't allow G.G. on the bandstand with him.
